pages.title: Neon lights · 1/3
paragraphs: It is late afternoon on a bright street in Las Vegas. Neon signs flash in blue, red and gold. Davi and his family walk toward a big theater. A short line waits at the ticket window. A woman named Tess works behind the glass. She calls the next person.
“Next, please. Which show do you want?” says Tess. “We want the magic show tonight.” says Davi. “Okay. How many tickets do you need?” says Tess.

pages.title: Neon lights · 3/3
paragraphs: “Here is my card. Do you have a program?” says Davi. “Yes. We have four tickets. Here you go!” says Tess. Davi pays two hundred dollars by card. Tess gives him four tickets and a small program. At seven thirty, the family walks into the theater. They find four seats in the middle row. The lights go down and the music starts. A good show is a gift for the whole family.
